tool_schemas.name: web_search_exa
tool_schemas.description: Runs an Exa-powered web vertical search for the provided query and returns up to numResults normalized results (e.g., title, URL, snippet/summary, and any available extracted text), with no pagination support in this endpoint (increase numResults to retrieve more). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is missing/empty or numResults is not a positive number, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to use Exa search. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the account has exhausted its configured usage/cost limits, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when Exa fails or times out.

numResults.description: Number of search results to return (default: 5)

tool_schemas.name: research_paper_search_exa
tool_schemas.description: Runs an Exa-powered “papers” vertical search for the provided query and returns up to numResults scholarly results with normalized metadata (e.g., title, authors/venue when available, URL, and snippet/summary), with no pagination support in this endpoint. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is missing/empty or numResults is not a positive number, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to use Exa search. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when usage/cost limits are exceeded, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when Exa cannot fulfill the request.

numResults.description: Number of research papers to return (default: 5)

tool_schemas.name: company_research_exa
tool_schemas.description: Runs an Exa-powered company-focused search for companyName and returns up to numResults normalized results relevant to the company (e.g., official site, profiles, news/overview sources), with no pagination support in this endpoint. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if companyName is missing/empty or numResults is not a positive number, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to use this vertical. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the account’s usage/cost limits are exceeded, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when Exa fails or times out.

companyName.description: Name of the company to research

numResults.description: Number of search results to return (default: 5)

tool_schemas.name: crawling_exa
tool_schemas.description: Submits a crawl/extract for the provided url and returns extracted page content and metadata truncated to maxCharacters (when available), with no pagination support. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if url is missing/invalid or maxCharacters is not a positive number, NOT_FOUND when the URL cannot be fetched or yields no retrievable document, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when crawling/extraction is not permitted for the caller. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when usage/cost limits are exceeded, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when Exa fails, times out, or refuses the extraction.

url.description: URL to crawl and extract content from

tool_schemas.name: competitor_finder_exa
tool_schemas.description: Runs an Exa-powered competitor discovery search for companyName (optionally scoped by industry) and returns up to numResults competitor candidates as normalized results, with no pagination support in this endpoint. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if companyName is missing/empty or numResults is not a positive number, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to use this vertical. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when usage/cost limits are exceeded, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when Exa fails or times out.

companyName.description: Name of the company to find competitors for

tool_schemas.name: linkedin_search_exa
tool_schemas.description: Runs an Exa-powered LinkedIn vertical search for the provided query and optional searchType filter (profiles, companies, all) and returns up to numResults normalized LinkedIn results, with no pagination support. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is missing/empty, searchType is not one of the allowed values, or numResults is not a positive number, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to query this vertical. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when usage/cost limits are exceeded, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when Exa fails, times out, or refuses the request.

query.description: LinkedIn search query (e.g., person name, company, job title)

searchType.description: Type of LinkedIn content to search (default: all)

numResults.description: Number of LinkedIn results to return (default: 5)

tool_schemas.name: wikipedia_search_exa
tool_schemas.description: Runs an Exa-powered Wikipedia vertical search for the provided query and returns up to numResults normalized article results (e.g., title, URL, snippet/summary), with no pagination support. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is missing/empty or numResults is not a positive number, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to use this vertical. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when usage/cost limits are exceeded, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when Exa fails or times out.

query.description: Wikipedia search query (topic, person, place, concept, etc.)

numResults.description: Number of Wikipedia articles to return (default: 5)

tool_schemas.name: github_search_exa
tool_schemas.description: Runs an Exa-powered GitHub vertical search for the provided query and optional searchType filter (repositories, code, users, all) and returns up to numResults normalized GitHub results, with no pagination support. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is missing/empty, searchType is not one of the allowed values, or numResults is not a positive number, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to query this vertical. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when usage/cost limits are exceeded, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when Exa fails, times out, or refuses the request.

query.description: GitHub search query (repository name, programming language, username, etc.)

searchType.description: Type of GitHub content to search (default: all)

numResults.description: Number of GitHub results to return (default: 5)

tool_schemas.name: list_search_requests_exa
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted search_requests for the calling API key, optionally filtered by status/vertical/toolName and time range, and returns a paginated page sorted by created_at descending. Refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the presented API key is invalid or not active, and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters/pagination.

apiKey.description: Exa Search API key used to authorize and attribute the request (must be active).

toolName.description: Filter by tool that created the request.

createdAfter.description: Only include requests created at or after this UTC timestamp (inclusive).

createdBefore.description: Only include requests created before this UTC timestamp (exclusive).

pageToken.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: get_search_request_exa
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single persisted search_requests row by id (including operational fields like status, latency, and upstream_request_id). Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist for the calling API key, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the presented API key is invalid or not active.

apiKey.description: Exa Search API key used to authorize and attribute the request (must be active).

tool_schemas.name: list_search_results_exa
tool_schemas.description: Lists normalized search_results for a given search_request_id, ordered by rank ascending. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the search_request_id does not exist for the calling API key, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the presented API key is invalid or not active.

apiKey.description: Exa Search API key used to authorize and attribute the request (must be active).

searchRequestId.description: search_requests.id whose results will be returned.

pageToken.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: list_crawl_jobs_exa
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted crawl_jobs for the calling API key, optionally filtered by status and time range, and returns a paginated page sorted by created_at descending. Refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the presented API key is invalid or not active, and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters/pagination.

apiKey.description: Exa Search API key used to authorize and attribute the request (must be active).

createdAfter.description: Only include jobs created at or after this UTC timestamp (inclusive).

createdBefore.description: Only include jobs created before this UTC timestamp (exclusive).

pageToken.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: get_crawl_job_exa
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single persisted crawl_jobs row by id. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist for the calling API key, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the presented API key is invalid or not active.

apiKey.description: Exa Search API key used to authorize and attribute the request (must be active).

tool_schemas.name: cancel_job_exa
tool_schemas.description: Cancels a running or queued search_requests or crawl_jobs entry by driving its lifecycle status transition to cancelled. Returns the updated job record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if the transition is invalid (e.g., already succeeded/failed/cancelled), NOT_FOUND if the id is not owned by the calling API key, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the presented API key is invalid or not active.

apiKey.description: Exa Search API key used to authorize and attribute the request (must be active).

id.description: The id of the job (search_requests.id or crawl_jobs.id).

reason.description: Optional human-readable cancellation reason to persist into error_message when applicable.
